```{r libraries}
#load in packages
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(effsize)
```


```{r data path}
#find data path 
file_path <- file.path('../../experiments/InfoShuffle/data/raw_behavioral_data/fullrando_tempmem')

csv_path <- list.files(path = file_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = T, full.names = T)

```

```{r loop}
#loop to pull columns of interest from each csv 
tempmem_allsubs <- c()

for(i in 1:length(csv_path)){
  data <- read.csv(csv_path[i])
  
  data <- data %>%
    select(participant, block, csv_filename, test_file, thisN, image_filename,
           StudyTrialResp.keys, StudyTrialResp.rt, estimated_minutes, estimated_seconds,
           left_image, right_image, left_original_position, right_original_position,
           correct_answer, pairType, TestLoop.TestResp.keys, TestLoop.TestResp.corr,
           TestLoop.TestResp.rt, DistractorLoop.thisRepN, expName
           )
  
  c("participant", "block", "csv_filename", "test_file", "thisN", "image_filename",
                     "StudyTrialResp.keys", "StudyTrialResp.rt", "estimated_minutes",
                     "estimated_seconds", "left_image", "right_image",
                     "left_original_position", "right_original_position", "correct_answer",
                     "pairType", "TestLoop.TestResp.keys", "TestLoop.TestResp.corr", "TestLoop.TestResp.rt",
                     "DistractorLoop.thisRepN", "expName")
  
  
  tempmem_allsubs <- rbind(tempmem_allsubs, data)
}

```

```{r creating condition column}
#create a condition column (blocked vs shuffled)
tempmem_allsubs$condition = NA

#trim "csv_filename" to just have "sequence_X"
tempmem_allsubs$csv_filename <- str_extract(tempmem_allsubs$csv_filename, "sequence.*")

tempmem_allsubs <- tempmem_allsubs %>%
  mutate(condition = case_when(str_detect(csv_filename, "\\d") ~ "shuffled",
                               TRUE ~ "blocked"))

```

```{r exclusions}
exclude_ids <- c(22, 28, 38, 50)

tempmem_allsubs <- tempmem_allsubs[!(tempmem_allsubs$participant %in% exclude_ids), ]
```


```{r time estimates}
#filter the df so that there's no NAs in the estimated minutes/seconds columns
minutes_allsubs <- tempmem_allsubs[!is.na(tempmem_allsubs$estimated_seconds),]

#combine to total seconds
minutes_allsubs$total_seconds <- minutes_allsubs$estimated_minutes * 60 + minutes_allsubs$estimated_seconds


#get the average for each participant, then pivot to wide format for ttest 
minutes_wide <- aggregate(minutes_allsubs, total_seconds ~ condition + participant, mean)
minutes_wide <- pivot_wider(minutes_wide, names_from = condition, values_from = total_seconds)

#paired ttest
t.test(minutes_wide$shuffled, minutes_wide$blocked, paired = T)

#cohen's d
cohen.d(minutes_wide$shuffled, minutes_wide$blocked, paired = T)

```

```{r temporal order memory}
#descriptives (mean, standard deviation)
tempmem_descriptives <- aggregate(TestLoop.TestResp.corr ~  condition + pairType + participant, tempmem_allsubs, function(x) c(mean = mean(x), sd = sd(x)))
  

#GLME: Effect of condition (across boundary trials only)
tempmem_condition <- tempmem_allsubs %>%
  filter(pairType == "across-boundary")

tempmem_condition_lme <- glmer(data = tempmem_condition, family = binomial, TestLoop.TestResp.corr ~ condition + (1 | participant))
summary(tempmem_condition_lme)

tempmem_cond_coeffs <- exp(fixef(tempmem_condition_lme))


#GLME: Effect of pair type (blocked trials only)
tempmem_pairtype <- tempmem_allsubs %>%
  filter(condition == "blocked")

tempmem_pairtype_lme <- glmer(data = tempmem_pairtype, family = binomial, TestLoop.TestResp.corr ~ pairType + (1 | participant))
summary(tempmem_pairtype_lme)

tempmem_pairtype_coeffs <- exp(fixef(tempmem_pairtype_lme))

```
